13/G.goal: Describe the complete view of a virtual reality system and classify its main hardware categories and input-device types.
13/G.achieves: Provides the foundational hardware and system model needed to follow later XR hardware/software, human-factors, development, and optimization topics and to implement an XR system with confidence.

13/O1.goal: Describe the complete view of a virtual reality system as comprising the user/organism, VR hardware, and surrounding physical environment, and explain how stimulation and tracking data flows connect them.
13/O1.achieves: Equips the learner with a system-level understanding of VR interaction that supports later study of VR/AR hardware, software, human factors, and system design.

13/O2.goal: Identify the three main functional categories of VR hardware and describe the major hand-based and non-hand-based input devices, their examples, trade-offs, and the reason multimodal input is preferred.
13/O2.achieves: Supports the learner in recognizing appropriate VR hardware options and input modalities when understanding requirements, designing, or implementing an XR system.
